clientId.title: Client ID
clientId.description: rasa.io v2 API client ID, generated in the rasa.io dashboard

clientSecret.title: Client Secret
clientSecret.description: rasa.io v2 API client secret, generated alongside the client ID

baseUrl.title: API host (optional)
baseUrl.description: Leave blank for rasa.io production (https://api.rasa.io). Set only to reach another rasa.io environment, e.g. https://api-dev.rasa.io for keys generated in rasa.io's dev dashboard.
